negative_reviews.author: K B
negative_reviews.text:
Whoever runs this restaurant should be ashame!
First of all, this is my second bad time, the first time was also bad but the food is good so i decided to bring my friends, so we went in again, but no one welcome us, had to find our own dirty table, then the menu took 10 minutes to arrive, but the server was good he kept apologising. Then the food took another 30 minutes to arrive, this time it was so overcook the squid actually became so chewy we didn’t even finish it. Then the drinks, another 10 more minutes or so, my was so sweet and can’t taste any alcohol at all. So in the end the server gave us free drinks, but i still think we should be happy and satisfy with our service. And we are not!
I have many restaurants myself and this is not the right way to run a business.
So my conclusion, seeing the servers running on but ignoring customers is a pity, the restaurant owner should hire more staff, they have only three but it’s a big restaurant, and the servers is also the bartender? Where is your standard ? This is how u get bankrupt!
If i can give zero star i would give to who ever own the restaurant, but the extra star is for the servers because they are only doing there job.
So how do u plan to compensate my appalling experience?

negative_reviews.author: daisy mcphaze
negative_reviews.text: Food was lovely. Great sushi, katsu curry etc. Service was a let down. Very slow on a quiet early evening. Drinks and edamame (which we were told was to snack on while we waited) didn't arrive until our meal was served (after 20 mins). 2 of our party of 4 had their food delivered first, waited another 5 minutes before another was served and then I waited another 5-10 minutes for mine. I might expect this from wagamamas, but it was ultimately quite frustrating at the start.

negative_reviews.author: Br7u Ffitch
negative_reviews.text: The food was alright , when we went they were handing out free dumplings so we ordered them to no where did it say they we couldn't use it with our £5 deal not the app and not on the card . Nor did the person taking our order tell us ending up paying more than we wanted as a student no ones to do that . Please tell customers when they can not do something also took 20 mins to get the bill after trying to get the attention of the workers bear in mind although it was lunch only 5 tables where in and all was accounted for .
